annotations.title: Wait for an index to build

description: Poll an index until its build is ready or has failed. Every poll is a metered request (starting 1 second apart, slowing to 10 seconds); the result says how many were made. A failed build is an error; running out of time returns timedOut: true with buildStatus "building".

index.description: The index: its id or pathName

list.description: The list: its id or pathName
